• Origin: Africa
  • Growth rate: Medium
  • Height: 10 - 20+ cm (average height after two months in the tank)
  • Light demand: Medium
  • CO2: Medium
Easy to maintain and suitable for beginners and experts alike. Regular trimming keeps the plant compact and bushy.

Hygrophila odora is a vibrant, fast-growing plant that adds a fresh, bright green touch to any aquarium. Known for its bushy, dense foliage, it is suited to aquascapers who want to quickly fill midground or background spaces with greenery. It is undemanding and thrives in a variety of water conditions and lighting levels, although moderate lighting gives the best results.

With regular trimming it keeps a compact, bushy shape. Its fresh green colour also contrasts well with red or darker-toned plants.
